# Fully pinned environment of the join-race-py310 CI leg (.github/workflows/ci.yml).
# uv.lock cannot be used there: it is resolved for CPython 3.13 only, and some of
# its pins (networkx 3.6.1, zarr 2.18.7) need Python >= 3.11. These are the
# versions pip resolved on CPython 3.10 for the engine's minimal install (torch
# CPU, numpy, chess), the client extras the worker-site tests import (pyyaml,
# zarr, requests) and pytest, frozen so the leg cannot drift.
